sloka: तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् ।राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ ।। ६.५९.९७ ।।।।
transliteration: tamāha saumitriravismayāno garjantamudvṛttasitāgradaṁṣṭram ।rājanna garjanti mahāprabhāvā vikatthase pāpakṛtāṁ variṣṭha ।। 6.59.97 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."
